thread:
Ari (PM): Quick sync — we have customer request to map cost spikes to user journeys. Proposal: small Console page that surfaces cost-by-route and a sampling hook for full traces when requests exceed a token or cost threshold.

Rashid (Eng): Implementation idea: runtime checks per-request; if tokens>800 OR token_cost_usd>0.04 then mark candidate. Apply reservoir sampling of 1% on candidates to bound volume. Store full trace only for sampled candidates, otherwise store metrics-only.

Priya (CS): Customer asks org-level opt-in, exportable bundles for security review, and PII scrubbing. They want to try only on their org first.

Rashid (Eng): We'll add per-org feature toggle + consent flag. Redaction: remove common PII fields and truncate bodies > 250KB, tag traces as TRUNCATED. Need SRE approval for retention defaults.

SREBot: Note: watch ingestion QPS and storage. Recommend a max_trace_bytes=262144 and a circuit breaker that disables sampling org-side if storage usage spikes.

Ari (PM): Minimal Console deliverables for beta: (1) cost-by-route timeseries, (2) top-10 cost contributors, (3) sampled-trace viewer with redaction metadata, (4) export button. Launch criteria: telemetry wired, per-org toggle works, redaction verified, rollback guard in place.

Priya (CS): Add rollback guard request: auto-disable sampling if 5xx rate increases >0.2% absolute or p95 latency regresses by >40ms within 10 minutes. We'll need an alert flow to CS.

Rashid (Eng): ETA: alpha in 1 week, beta for org in 2 weeks assuming infra tests pass. I'll open a short PR with config, rate limits, and storage calc.

Ari (PM): Thanks — let's aim for a short demo for the customer after beta smoke tests. Keep follow-ups in the PR.
